ruleDefinitions.name: LSASS Access Detected via Attack Surface Reduction
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Access to LSASS Process Note: Unmapped fields: Path, ProcessName

sequences.query: (event_id = 1121 AND Path = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT ((ProcessName = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\asgard2\\-agent\\\\") AND (ProcessName = RGX("\\\\thor64\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\thor\\\.exe$"))) OR (ProcessName = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\atiesrxx\.exe" OR ProcessName = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\CompatTelRunner\.exe" OR ProcessName = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec\.exe" OR ProcessName = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\nvwmi64\.exe" OR ProcessName = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost\.exe" OR ProcessName = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\Taskmgr\.exe" OR ProcessName = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\WmiPrvSE\.exe" OR ProcessName = "C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\msiexec\.exe") OR (ProcessName = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\DriverStore\\\\") OR ProcessName = RGX("^C\\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\Installer\\\\") OR ProcessName = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR ProcessName = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\")))
